top_categories.workout_context: GFNY Pérez Zeledón's fast opening into sustained tropical climbing rewards road-specific control. Practice smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 71 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Pérez Zeledón's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
71 miles on fast opening into sustained tropical climbing burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
87ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At GFNY Pérez Zeledón, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
6,243ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Pérez Zeledón. Train it until it feels boring.
6,243ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Base fitness for GFNY Pérez Zeledón. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Pérez Zeledón. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on fast opening into sustained tropical climbing can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Low-cadence force work supports 6,243ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Pérez Zeledón's 71 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, carry enough for gaps between stops, and confirm the organizer’s current resupply locations before race day.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at GFNY Pérez Zeledón. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Pérez Zeledón rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on fast opening into sustained tropical climbing to build confidence.
